_note: Routing policy: the INTENTS an agent/task declares instead of a hard-coded model. Each intent is a hard-constraint problem — filter models by the ceilings/floor + provider allowlist, then optimize the objective. This is the ONE file you tune to change the cost/latency/accuracy posture of the whole crew. Posture (reshaped 2026-07-24 for Opus 5): OPUS 5 is the insta-upgrade flagship for accuracy-critical strategy + advisory; SONNET 5 stays the code workhorse; FABLE 5 is reserved for the ONE frontier role that earns it, adversarial security (red-team); the TOP-LEVEL session (overlord) + all PROSE (writing) go cross-vendor OFF Anthropic on purpose (overlord -> OpenAI GPT, writing -> Google Gemini) because Claude is the weak writer and a same-vendor orchestrator/author has the same blind spots; peer REVIEW -> Google Gemini Pro, a third vendor from both the GPT orchestrator and the Claude authors. Vendor spread is now: orchestrate=OpenAI, code/strategy/advisory/security=Anthropic, review/writing/verify/breadth=Google. Provider allowlists encode that on purpose. Cost caps below are per-task USD at ~20k in + 6k out. Override at ~/.pix/routing/policy.json.

intents.name: overlord
intents.about: The TOP-LEVEL interactive orchestrator (the 'overlord' that directs the whole subagent crew and does little itself). Steered OFF Anthropic on purpose: Claude is the weak writer/communicator and a same-vendor orchestrator shares its authors' blind spots. Best OpenAI reasoner. -> GPT-5.6 Sol.

intents.name: strategy
intents.about: Accuracy-critical judgment/synthesis where a wrong call is expensive and hard to detect: architecture, product strategy. Best Anthropic reasoner under an Opus-tier cost cap (the cap excludes the Fable frontier, now reserved for security). -> Opus 5 (insta-upgrade from Opus 4.8).

intents.name: max-accuracy
intents.about: The one genuinely-hard sub-problem or whole-story implementation that needs the strongest reasoning and a big context (the `deep` worker). Post-Opus-5 the frontier tier for HARD WORK is Opus 5, not Fable (Fable is reserved for security red-team); the cost cap excludes Fable so this resolves to Opus 5. -> Opus 5.

intents.name: code
intents.about: Production code/design on the primary production vendor, best value under a per-task cap. -> Sonnet 5 (Anthropic's own recommendation for most coding).

intents.name: advisory
intents.about: The specialist ADVISOR crew (finance, legal, sre, dx-consultant, enterprise-admin): high-leverage judgment where a wrong recommendation is expensive. The prose specialists (devrel, growth, ux, enrich) moved to the `writing` intent. Best Anthropic reasoner under an Opus-tier cap. -> Opus 5. (Toggle to cross-vendor by setting providers:[openai] -> GPT-5.6 Sol.)

intents.name: reasoning
intents.about: General-purpose reasoning for ad-hoc `--intent reasoning` use (no vendor lock). Best accuracy under a mid-tier cost cap across all vendors.

intents.name: review
intents.about: Adversarial second opinion / peer review. Prefers Google: a THIRD vendor, distinct from both the OpenAI orchestrator and the Anthropic authors (code/strategy) whose work it checks, so its blind spots genuinely differ. Opus would be same-vendor as the authors and is the wrong reviewer. -> Gemini 3.1 Pro (reasoning/GPQA leader).

intents.name: red-team
intents.about: Adversarial security scrutiny (STRIDE/OWASP/supply-chain). This is the ONE frontier role that earns Fable 5: getting a security review wrong is the most expensive miss in the crew, so it gets the strongest model regardless of cost, no ceiling. -> Fable 5.

intents.name: authoring
intents.about: Powers the agentic `agent new` flow that drafts prompts + writes eval cases. Needs strong judgment + valid structured output. -> Opus 5 (best Anthropic reasoner under an Opus-tier cap).

intents.name: breadth
intents.about: Cheap, fast parallel fan-out. Cheapest model clearing an accuracy floor + latency ceiling. -> Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite (the volume floor).

intents.name: verify
intents.about: Test/QA passes: fast + cheap, but Haiku was the dumb pick for it. Prefers Google for the best fast QA model (Pro excluded on the 20s latency cap, Flash-Lite on the accuracy floor). -> Gemini 3.6 Flash.

intents.name: fast-balanced
intents.about: Snappy interactive work that wants more smarts than the volume floor but can't wait on a frontier model: balanced accuracy/cost/latency within a hard sub-10s tier (excludes Pro/Sol/Terra/Sonnet on latency) above a 0.65 accuracy floor (excludes Flash-Lite). -> Gemini 3.6 Flash (fast, mid-accuracy, beats Haiku on the blend).

intents.name: writing
intents.about: PROSE: product copy, docs, tutorials, marketing, knowledge writeups (ux-copywriter, devrel, growth-marketing, enrich). Steered OFF Anthropic because Claude is the weak writer; cheapest Google model clearing a 0.70 quality floor. -> Gemini 3.6 Flash. (Bump to Gemini 3.1 Pro for higher-stakes prose by setting objective:accuracy.)
